language.label: Language
language.hint: Applies right away and is kept on this Mac.
language.saveFailed: The language could not be saved.

validation.gitUrl: Must be an https:// or git@ address.
validation.httpsUrl: Must be an address starting with https://.
validation.windowsAppUrl: Must be a link starting with {schemes}.
validation.port: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.

account.label: Claude account
account.sshHint: Ignored for SSH projects: accounts live on {machine}.
account.hint: This project's terminals open with this account's subscription.

projects.fixedBuiltin: The built-in project's location cannot be changed
projects.fixedGithub: The GitHub address cannot be changed
projects.locationNote: A project with cards keeps its location. Open terminals stay where they are; new ones open in the new location.

agentsBrowser.label: Background agents use this browser too
agentsBrowser.hint: Kokpit writes the browser's address into the project's Claude settings file, so agents running in the background (claude agents) also connect to this Chrome. The rest of the file is left untouched. Choosing No removes its own lines. The change applies to newly started agents.

openInBrowser.label: Terminal open command uses this browser
openInBrowser.hint: In this project's terminals, "open <http(s) address>" and "open <page.html>" show the page in the project's Kokpit browser instead of the desktop browser on {machine}. Every other open command works as usual. The change applies to newly opened terminals.

browserWindow.hint: While hidden, the browser opens no window on the {machine} screen; it shows only in Kokpit's Browser panel. {why}. Changing this restarts the open browser; tabs come back.

runOn.label: Where the browser opens
runOn.profileNote: The agent can access this profile's password manager and signed-in sessions.

tools.defaultToolHint: New terminals open with this when the project has no tool chosen.
tools.commandHint: Typed into the shell when the terminal opens.
tools.checkCommandHint: A command that exits with 0 if the tool is installed.
tools.patternsHint: One regular expression per line. If one appears in the terminal's last lines, the agent counts as “waiting for you”. If empty, the general patterns are used.

servers.keyHint: Private key files in ~/.ssh; only their names are shown.

sites.onlyInApp: Sites can only be edited in the Kokpit app.
sites.intro: The sites in the Go menu, in this order. Each site opens in its own tab in the Web panel; its login is kept on this computer. The address must be https://; http:// is accepted only for Tailscale or local IP addresses (e.g. http://100.x.y.z:9119) and is marked "http · Tailscale": it is unencrypted and loads only while Tailscale is on and the address is in your tailnet.

claude.credentialsNote: Sign-in details stay in this folder or in the macOS Keychain; Kokpit does not read them. To sign in, use “Sign in”.
claude.shareNote: The skills, agents and commands folders in {dir} are symlinked to the default account's; existing ones are left untouched.
claude.loginFailed: Could not open the sign-in terminal: {error}
claude.defaultBadgeTitle: This account's terminals get no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
claude.configDirHint: Must be inside your home folder; created if missing. Nothing is deleted.
claude.fixedDir: The default account's folder cannot change: {dir}
